name: @nulib/clover
description: Composable IIIF components for the web: Clover 4.x, in development.

scripts.build: npm run clean && vite build && node build/styles.mjs && npm run build:types && npm run build:web-components && npm run build:sizes
scripts.build:types: dts-bundle-generator --project tsconfig.json --out-file dist/index.d.mts src/index.ts --no-check && dts-bundle-generator --project tsconfig.json --out-file dist/templates/index.d.mts src/templates/index.ts --no-check && dts-bundle-generator --project tsconfig.json --out-file dist/map/index.d.mts src/map/index.ts --no-check
scripts.build:web-components: vite build --config build/web-components.config.mjs && cp build/web-components-loader.js dist/web-components/index.umd.js
